narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -7.22 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.03397-0.03414 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.03515; the first objective pays 1.38R at 0.03363.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.03397-0.03414
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.03515 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 24/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering
